title: File I/O & Standard Packages
intro: Learn Go I/O as a set of precise, composable contracts: open files with intentional flags and permissions; choose whole-file or streaming work from real size bounds; close resources at the right scope; scan and buffer without losing errors; implement Reader and Writer count rules; copy streams with limits and fast paths; construct portable paths with a real containment boundary; and load typed configuration without unsafe process-global test state. Each lesson includes a runnable example and focuses on the failure modes that matter in production.
